results.label: lem:direct-radix
results.relation: 两种字长分支均给出线性 I/O 和多项式磁盘空间。宽字分支的显式分配界与证明末尾的 O(NB) 字估计有别。
results.relation_en: Both word-width cases give linear I/O and polynomial disk space. The wide-word allocation bound differs from the O(NB)-word estimate at the end of the paper proof.
results.title_en: A linear number of individual record accesses
results.title_zh: 线性次数的逐条记录访问

results.label: lem:buffered-tape
results.relation: initialized_controller_transfer_bound 证明单带的三块窗口传输界。论文对固定条数的磁带和各阶段求和，并将位块宽代入为 Bw；排序的 Lean 证明直接构造流扫描程序并证明其执行与费用。
results.relation_en: initialized_controller_transfer_bound proves the three-block-window transfer bound for one tape. The paper sums over a fixed number of tapes and over stages, substituting Bw for the bit-block width; the Lean sorting proof directly constructs stream-scan programs and proves their execution and cost.

results.label: lem:io-normalization
results.relation: run_represents_and_cost 给出模拟；固定资源参数由 CommonSortingNormalization 等模块选择
results.relation_en: run_represents_and_cost supplies simulation; CommonSortingNormalization and related modules choose fixed resources

results.label: cor:parameter-transfer
results.relation: factor_transfer、with_scans 与最终参数分支结合。排序界覆盖全部 2B ≤ M；地址字段交换仍要求 M 达到固定阈值 C_abs。
results.relation_en: factor_transfer and with_scans combine with the final parameter cases. The sorting bounds cover all 2B ≤ M; address-field interchange still requires M to reach the fixed threshold C_abs.

results.label: lem:arbitrary-fields
results.relation: 程序执行的块传输次数上界针对后缀长度为字长整数倍的数组，填充时补齐合并后的前缀行数。
results.relation_en: The bound on block transfers during program execution uses suffixes containing a whole number of words and pads the combined prefix rows.
results.title_en: Interchange for arbitrary field widths and prefix counts
results.title_zh: 一般字段宽度与前缀段数下的交换
